restriction_summary: B04/B24 one exposure; only B04 inspected; no restricted originals used
source_observations: N19 supplies fine standing legs, continuous full trunk, tiny nub and close smooth coat. N25 confirms smooth chest and neck in supported rest.
B04 and B29 show close dark torso, substantial legs and clearance; B19 supplies localized furnishings in rest, not standing proportions.

Shared models are provisional. The finish calibration contains patterned body strokes; it is not permission to extend coat length. Staging already carries the shaggy Buddy contour and apparently closed snack packet; these needed correction before finish.

observations: Buddy upper-back contour is now a close continuous body edge rather than projecting spikes. Shoulder and leg shafts read clipped, with slight fine paint marks but no enlarged shag volume. Ear and muzzle furnishings remain regional.

Buddy keeps connected full ribcage, neck and pelvis; four legs remain properly owned and supported on mattress, with substantial shafts and real belly clearance. Tail remains tapering rather than a plume.
Neet retains fine legs, full narrow torso, broad triangular ears, tiny nub and close silhouette. Interior paint marks do not add long coat volume.

Suitcase hinge, lid, socks and base remain coherent on bed. Neet still stands inside suitcase; Buddy muzzle contacts blue blanket at rim. No sweater replacement or human added; original captain versus comfort joke intact.

Neet braces four owned legs within left crate. Front paws spread and hindlegs connect to rear torso; no floor penetration or extra limb. Broad sideways ears and modest muzzle read uncertain rather than triumphant.
Neet has a close silhouette without enlarged neck ruff. Fine interior short-coat strokes and restrained chest texture do not create the pronounced curled volume in the snack image.
Buddy lies on blue blanket with two clearly owned forepaws and connected shoulder/chest/torso receding leftward. Rear body is partly obscured by doorway; no floating head or false second body.
Buddy retains close dark upper body and localized pale muzzle/brow/ear furnishings; his head is raised toward Neet. Beige crates, blue floor/seats and window establish cabin and support.

At reassurance anchor Neet has not yet lain down; Buddy has lifted his head. Quiet contrast complements packing rather than repeating it. Tails are legitimately obscured; their length cannot be judged here.

Pretzel packet now has separated ragged silver top edges and a large dark open mouth; a pretzel projects beyond rim. It reads unmistakably opened rather than transparent sealed packaging. Hand grips side below opening with plausible finger ownership.
Neet cream bib and tan shoulders now read flatter color areas with short residual texture, no layered feathered tips or inflated neck ruff. Cream/tan boundary stays flush to chest contour.
Neet seated haunches, two forelegs, paired hindfeet and supported pelvis remain connected. Fine legs, modest muzzle, large ears and upward attention preserved.
Buddy remains supported on blue blanket with two owned forepaws and connected receding trunk. Localized beard/brows/ear furnishings preserved; no new floating or duplicated anatomy.

Beige crates, blue floor/seats, cream Neet bedding and blue Buddy blanket maintain continuity with retained reassurance. Meal cart stays behind. No snack already in Neet mouth or premature Buddy nibbling.
The physical reversal from braced captain to perfectly upright snack attention remains readable. Black packet interior is simplified but geometrically understandable; no material finish regression.
